contract: DataService loads retry every Config.Data.LoadRetryDelay = 6 s, LoadRetries = 5 tries; the 5th takes a live lock (~24 s). The first retry wait sets the player attribute SaveLoading = true and sends one Notify Config.Text.SaveLoading ('Loading your save…', kind info); DataService.Load clears the attribute (nil) on every outcome. Locks carry Studio = true when written by Studio; a lock with JobId '' or Studio = true is never live for a non-Studio server (no wait), while Studio still waits for live locks. StudioFreshSave (ServerStorage attribute) is read only when RunService:IsStudio(): a live server never reads it and never enters memory mode because of it.
limitations: DataStore double (no real latency, throttling or UpdateAsync conflicts beyond the scripted ones); Studio's real JobId and the live Studio Play / publish flow are not exercised here.
